description_full: newcleo plc develops advanced modular, lead-cooled fast reactors and mixed oxide nuclear fuel from reprocessed nuclear materials. It conducts research and development activities related to nuclear energy, supports the closure of the nuclear fuel cycle, and delivers full-service engineering, procurement, and construction capabilities. The company operates a pilot line for MOX fuel manufacturing and engages in projects focused on energy independence using advanced nuclear technology. It serves clients in the nuclear industry, including nuclear operators and entities involved in reactor design, fuel manufacturing, and energy independence initiatives. The company has a collaboration with Curio Legacy Ventures, Inc. for the supply of recycled used nuclear fuel and transuranic materials for the production of mixed-oxide fuel. newcleo plc was founded in 2021 and is based in London, the United Kingdom.
